sectionThree.heading: Built Around the Demands of the Project
paragraphs: Every project site is different. Access roads, delivery windows, unloading arrangements and cargo dimensions all shape how a movement should be planned, so we start with the cargo and the site before we assign a vehicle.

LMI has supported highway and infrastructure projects in Pakistan for decades, moving bitumen and petroleum products to project sites on routes across Sindh, Punjab, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan. An assured fleet network of verified trucks and drivers is ready exactly when required, so site schedules are not left waiting.
Drivers follow our HSE protocols on the road and on site, from pre-trip checks to safe loading and unloading.

items.question: Do you transport bitumen to road project sites?
items.answer: Yes. Bitumen transportation to refineries, plants and highway project sites is one of our longest-standing services.

items.question: Can you move machinery and fabricated steel?
items.answer: Yes. We use flatbed and project cargo configurations suited to the size and weight of the load.

items.question: Do you serve remote project locations?
items.answer: Yes. Our drivers are trained for national highways, motorways, link roads, mountain passes and difficult terrain in remote areas.

items.question: Can you support recurring site deliveries?
items.answer: Yes. We plan repeat deliveries around your project schedule, backed by an assured fleet network ready exactly when required.

items.question: How do I request a quote?
items.answer: Tell us the cargo, weight and dimensions, pickup point, site location and timeline, and our team will recommend a transportation approach.
